title: Quasi-coherent submodules of the structure sheaf are ideal modules
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], M a quasi-coherent O_X-module [pqf-def-coherent], and i:M → O_X a monomorphism of sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. There exist ideal sheaf data J on X, with J.toModules quasi-coherent, and an isomorphism M ≅ J.toModules. No affine, quasi-compact, finite-generation or Noetherian hypothesis is assumed.

source.place: Tag 01XF, label lemma-quasi-compact-h1-zero-covering, paragraph constructing F_i as the intersection with the first i direct summands; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01XF

proof.text: For an affine open U define J(U) as the range of the linear map i on U-sections. It is an ideal because the target is the section ring as a module over itself. Naturality shows that restricting elements of J(U) to D(f) lands in J(D(f)). For the reverse containment, lift a section m over D(f) after multiplying by a power of f, using exists_map_eq_pow_smul_of_isAffineOpen. Applying i expresses the corresponding power multiple of its image as the restriction of i(a), so it lies in the image ideal. The restriction of f is a unit on D(f), and unit_mul_mem_iff_mem cancels its power. Thus the ideal localization equalities hold and construct genuine IdealSheafData J, with its default support.

On every affine open, i(a) belongs to J(U); idealOfOpens_eq_ideal and mem_idealOfOpens_iff say that closed-subscheme restriction kills it. For an arbitrary open, restrict to all affine subopens and apply the sheaf condition to prove the same vanishing. Thus i followed by J.toPushforwardSubscheme is zero. Define l:M → J.toModules by kernel.lift; its composite with J.toModulesι is i.

Evaluation preserves monomorphisms, so i is injective on sections. Hence l is injective on sections. On each affine open range_toModulesι_app identifies the range of J.toModulesι with J(U), which is the range of i. This makes l surjective there as well. Apply the existing source lemma Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_bijective_app_of_isAffineOpen: the affine opens form a basis and an isomorphism on that basis is a sheaf isomorphism. Transport quasi-coherence along asIso l.

lean.statement:
theorem quasiCoherent_submodule_ideal (X : Scheme.{u}) {M : X.Modules}
    [M.IsQuasicoherent] (i : M ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) [Mono i] :
    ∃ J : X.IdealSheafData, J.toModules.IsQuasicoherent ∧
      Nonempty (M ≅ J.toModules)
